entries.title: Ezekiel 5:1
segments: ¶"And you, son of man, take a sharp sword, take it as a barber's razor, and pass [it] over your head and your beard; then take scales to weigh and divide the hair.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:2
segments: "You shall burn with fire one-third in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are finished; then you shall take one-third and strike around [it] with the sword, and one-third you shall scatter in the wind: I will draw out a sword after them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:3
segments: "You shall also take a small number of them and bind them in the edge of your [garment].

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:4
segments: "Then take some of them again and throw them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From there a fire will go out into all the house of Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:5
segments: ¶"Thus says the Lord GOD: 'This [is] Jerusalem; I have set her in the midst of the nations and the countries all around her.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:6
segments: 'She has rebelled against My judgments by doing wickedness more than the nations, and against My statutes more than the countries that [are] all around her; for they have refused My judgments, and they have not walked in My statutes.'

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:7
segments: "Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: 'Because you have multiplied [disobedience] more than the nations that [are] all around you, have not walked in My statutes nor kept My judgments, nor even done according to the judgments of the nations that [are] all around you' -

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:8
segments: "therefore thus says the Lord GOD: 'Indeed I, even I, [am] against you and will execute judgments in your midst in the sight of the nations.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:9
segments: 'And I will do among you what I have never done, and the like of which I will never do again, because of all your abominations.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:10
segments: 'Therefore fathers shall eat [their] sons in your midst, and sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments among you, and all of you who remain I will scatter to all the winds.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:11
segments: 'Therefore, [as] I live,' says the Lord GOD, 'surely, because you have defiled My sanctuary with all your detestable things and with all your abominations, therefore I will also diminish [you]; My eye will not spare, nor will I have any pity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:12
segments: 'One-third of you shall die of the pestilence, and be consumed with famine in your midst; and one-third shall fall by the sword all around you; and I will scatter another third to all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:13
segments: 'Thus shall My anger be spent, and I will cause My fury to rest upon them, and I will be avenged; and they shall know that I, the LORD, have spoken [it] in My zeal, when I have spent My fury upon them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:14
segments: 'Moreover I will make you a waste and a reproach among the nations that [are] all around you, in the sight of all who pass by.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:15
segments: 'So it shall be a reproach, a taunt, a lesson, and an astonishment to the nations that [are] all around you, when I execute judgments among you in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I, the LORD, have spoken.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:16
segments: 'When I send against them the terrible arrows of famine which shall be for destruction, which I will send to destroy you, I will increase the famine upon you and cut off your supply of bread.

entries.title: Ezekiel 5:17
segments: 'So I will send against you famine and wild beasts, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood shall pass through you, and I will bring the sword against you. I, the LORD, have spoken.'"
